text:
I'm sorry your peace lily is wilting. Unfortunately, I can't replace it: repotting into non-Leafy soil in the first 14 days isn't covered by our Plant Care Guarantee, and the 48-hour damaged-on-arrival window has also passed.

A Plant Care Specialist can give you free care advice by chat or email, which may help you save it. Meanwhile, keep it out of direct sun and water only when the top inch of soil is dry, since overwatering is a common cause of wilting in garden soil. If you think I've misunderstood your situation, I can escalate this to a Support Lead.
